name: TOEIC Master SaaS Architecture
description: Next.js Modular Monorepo Architecture for TOEIC SaaS Platform

diagrams.title: System Architecture (C4 Container)
diagrams.code:
flowchart TD
  subgraph Users [Users]
    Learner[Learner]
    Admin[System Admin]
  end

  subgraph Vercel [Frontend Cloud - Vercel / Docker]
    NextApp[Next.js App Router\nUI & BFF]
    NextAuth[Auth.js / NextAuth\nSession & Token]
    UI[Tailwind & Shadcn UI\nReact Components]
    NextApp --> NextAuth
    NextApp --> UI
  end

  subgraph VPS [Backend Cloud - VPS Docker]
    FastAPI[FastAPI AI Service\nCore Logic & LLM]
    Celery[Celery / BullMQ\nBackground Tasks]
  end

  subgraph DB [Data Layer]
    Postgres[(PostgreSQL\nMulti-tenant DB)]
    Redis[(Redis\nCache & Rate Limit)]
    VectorDB[(ChromaDB/Pinecone\nRAG Vocab)]
  end

  subgraph Ext [External Services]
    DeepSeek[DeepSeek/Gemini API]
    Stripe[Stripe / VNPay]
    Google[OAuth Providers]
  end

  Learner -->|HTTPS/WebSockets| NextApp
  Admin -->|HTTPS| NextApp

  NextAuth -->|OAuth2| Google
  NextApp -->|REST/gRPC| FastAPI
  NextApp -->|Prisma/Drizzle| Postgres
  NextApp -->|Stripe SDK| Stripe

  FastAPI -->|LLM Prompts| DeepSeek
  FastAPI -->|SQLAlchemy| Postgres
  FastAPI -->|Cache/Queue| Redis
  FastAPI -->|Vector Search| VectorDB
  Celery -.-> Redis
